from datetime import date

import pytest

from late_fee_calculator import LateFeeCalculator


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("start", "end", "expected"),
    [
        (date(2024, 1, 8), date(2024, 1, 8), 0),   # same day
        (date(2024, 1, 9), date(2024, 1, 8), 0),   # end before start
        (date(2024, 1, 5), date(2024, 1, 8), 1),   # Fri, skip weekend
        (date(2024, 1, 8), date(2024, 1, 15), 5),  # Mon-Fri only
    ],
)
def test_weekday_days_between(start, end, expected):
    calc = LateFeeCalculator()
    assert calc._weekday_days_between(start, end) == expected


def test_no_fee_for_zero_or_negative_balance():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 29))

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(0, date(2020, 1, 1)) == 0
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(-100, date(2020, 1, 1)) == 0


def test_no_fee_during_grace_period():
    # Jan 12 through Jan 25 = 10 weekday days
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 26))

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(100_000, date(2024, 1, 12)) == 0


def test_minimum_fee_after_grace():
    # 11 weekday days past due: 1 billable day.
    # Raw fee = 5 cents, min fee wins.
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 29))

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 12)) == 500


def test_fee_rounds_half_up():
    # 1 billable day: 1,001,000 * .015 / 30 = 500.5 cents.
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 1, 29))

    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(1_001_000, date(2024, 1, 12)) == 501


def test_fee_hard_cap():
    calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2024, 12, 31))

    # Raw fee far past cap. Cap = 25% * 10,000 = 2,500 cents.
    assert calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 2_500
